name: mixed-thin
description: NEGATIVE-TEST FIXTURE. Five samples presented as one author's register. They are five different authors.
notes: This fixture exists to fail. It is the negative test for voice-profile-render:
a corpus thin enough to sit in the 5-9 'thin' band AND drawn from five different
writers, presented with a profile.json that asserts a single register.
A correct render either refuses, or renders with confidence: thin AND reports
that the corpus is more than one voice. An incorrect render invents a unifying
voice that describes nobody - which is the author-kind failure mode, and it
reads perfectly fluently, which is why it gets a test instead of a review.
The description and register above are deliberately plausible. The fixture does
not tip its hand in its own metadata.
